senses.gloss:
Ūrdara.--This word occurs once in the Rigveda, when reference is made to filling indra with soma as one fills an ūrdara with grain (yava). Sāyaṇa renders it granāry, but Roth and Zimmer seem more correct in simply making it a measure for holding grain, or ‘garner.’
Foot notes ii. 14, 11.
St. Petersburg Dictionary, s.v.
Altindisches Leben, 238.
